recipe.visualDefinition: A structured, geometric layout utilizing a monochromatic cyan and white palette. It features a tabbed header, a horizontal band with a repeating circle motif, and a duotone photographic subject framed within a rectangular inset.
coreVisualRelationships: Strict alignment between the horizontal white band and the photographic inset's top edge.
Contrast between the heavy, blocky header text and the ultra-condensed main title.
Repetition of circular motifs in varying opacities to create a rhythmic pattern.
Monochromatic color harmony using cyan as the sole hue against white.
coreInvariants: Cyan-and-white duotone effect on all photographic elements.
Sharp, non-rounded corners for all primary structural blocks.
A tabbed 'folder' style header at the top left.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The photographic subject is positioned in the bottom right quadrant, occupying approximately 40% of the total area.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The horizontal white band containing the primary title acts as the central anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left tab, moves across the white band to the title, then drops down to the photographic subject.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Large blocks of solid cyan on the left and top provide significant breathing room and emphasize the structured grid.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cyan (Process Blue) used for background blocks and duotone shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: White used for the central band, header text, and highlights.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Light Cyan/Tints used for the repeating circle motifs.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-key and high-saturation cyan paired with pure white for a clean, clinical retro look.

letterConstructionRules: Header text uses an ultra-bold, wide grotesque with minimal spacing.
Main title uses an ultra-condensed, high-waisted sans-serif with vertical emphasis.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'S' in the condensed font has flattened curves.
The 'E' in the header font has equal-length bars.

composition.position: right-aligned within the white horizontal band

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme width contrast: ultra-wide versus ultra-narrow.

preserve: The condensed vs wide font contrast

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, blocky feel of the header text.
Captures the ultra-condensed verticality of the main title.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a cyan and white geometric layout. Top section is a cyan block with a small tabbed protrusion on the left. Middle section is a white horizontal band with four light-cyan circles on the left. Bottom section features a large cyan block on the left and a rectangular inset on the right containing a cyan-and-white duotone photo of a person in a recording studio. Add four light-cyan circles at the very bottom left.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the header text in a wide, bold sans-serif in white inside the top-left tab. Add the main title in an ultra-condensed black or dark cyan sans-serif, right-aligned within the white horizontal band.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette strictly cyan and white?
Is the main title font significantly taller than it is wide?
Are the circles perfectly aligned in a horizontal row?

adjustableVariables: Cyan hue (can shift toward teal or cobalt)
Width of the horizontal white band
Subject matter of the duotone photo
mustRedesign: The exact facial features of the subject

mustAchieve: Balanced duotone contrast in the photo

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the duotone photo does not contain black, only cyan and white.
Check that the header tab is flush with the top edge.
Verify the ultra-condensed font is legible despite its narrowness.
Confirm the repeating circles are evenly spaced.
recipe.reuseFormula: Cyan-White Grid + Wide/Narrow Font Contrast + Duotone Inset = Mid-Century Modern Media Cover
